summary: The caller-supplied 16-byte salt capability was added by this change. The fixed harness cannot exercise it because it calls only XML_SetHashSalt.

claims.necessity_reason: The review established this obligation; this turn assesses when it became applicable.

before.requirement: Exercise caller-supplied 16-byte salt through XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes before parsing.
before.reason: The before version has only the unsigned-long setter; the 16-byte setter did not yet exist. The harness's old setter call exercised the narrower existing API, not this later capability.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the before version's narrower setter.

after.requirement: Call XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes on the parser with a non-NULL 16-byte array before parsing, then parse a finite valid document.
after.reason: The added setter loads all 16 supplied bytes. The fixed harness calls XML_SetHashSalt instead, which forces the first key half to zero; no input changes that call.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Shows that the harness's old setter cannot supply the full key.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the parser creation and parse routes using ParseOneInput.

claims.comparison_reason: There was no before-version 16-byte setter to block. The old harness's fixed unsigned-long setter call becomes a coverage constraint only after the new API is added.
